photos.title: Landmark Resort and the Palace from above
photos.what: Landmark Resort and the Palace from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): Landmark Resort, a white-roofed oceanfront tower, stands on the beach at the center; its parking garage and water park lie across Ocean Boulevard to the upper left, joined to the tower by a covered walkway; the Palace, a tower with a blue-gray roof, stands on the beach at the lower left; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Landmark Resort from above, on the beach, with its garage and water park across Ocean Boulevard and the Palace next door.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Landmark Resort tower on the beach in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the Palace beside it and the Atlantic Ocean
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
